description:
About Us

Sieve is a multimodal data lab building high-quality training datasets and evaluation environments for frontier AI across audiovisual modeling, robotics, and multimodal interaction. We pair exabyte-scale data infrastructure and global data collection operations with multimodal research to help machines learn how the world looks, sounds, moves, and responds. Our work spans real and virtual environments, from large-scale video and audio to human demonstrations and evaluations of reasoning and action. We believe data creation deserves the same rigor as model development, and that a close connection between data production, model training, and evaluation is essential to building AI that can understand and interact with the world.

We partner with top AI labs and did $XXM last quarter alone, as a team of ~45 people. We also raised our Series A from Tier 1 firms such as Matrix Partners, Swift Ventures, Y Combinator, and AI Grant.


Why Now

Building the next generation of AI requires capturing data from the real world. We're expanding our hardware deployments across countries and need engineers who can get on the ground, figure things out, and make new sites work. You'll join early, own problems end-to-end, and help build the technical foundation for our international operations.

About the Role

You'll run daily camera deployments at our recording sites in and around Bengaluru, and be the face of Sieve to the workers and site managers there. You'll report to Founding Operations, in the respective country. We'll provide hardware, training, and a playbook for each site.

What You'll Do

  • Collect consent: Explain what we record, why, and how it's used, in the worker's language, and get signed or recorded consent before anyone wears a camera.

  • Deploy cameras: Fit cameras at the start of each shift, confirm they're recording, and collect them at the end.

  • Keep cameras running: Check every camera and wearer every 30 minutes and fix issues as they come up.

  • Look after workers: Answer questions honestly and help workers feel at ease.

  • Handle hardware and footage: Charge, label, and track devices, offload footage daily, and flag damaged or missing equipment.

  • Report daily: Log cameras deployed, hours recorded, and issues.

What Success Looks Like

  • Every worker on camera has given informed consent, with complete records.

  • Every camera is mounted, recording, and accounted for through the full shift.

  • Workers keep participating and site managers are happy to keep hosting us.

Requirements

  • Comfortable explaining consent and privacy in simple terms.

  • Able to track many devices and people at once.

  • Proactive, with a habit of regular follow-up.

  • Comfortable with basic hardware: charging, mounting, troubleshooting.

  • Kannada or Hindi, plus working English.

  • Willing to work full shifts on site and travel around Bengaluru.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with wearables, cameras, or field hardware.

  • Experience at a company collecting video or AI training data.

  • Experience in a factory, kitchen, warehouse, or shop-floor environment.
